topic: Chapter reaction: Sanji wins the Killingham fight by leading the giants, not by awakening Haki
title: Sanji's Real Weapon Against Killingham (One Piece 1193)
description: Fans keep asking if Sanji will awaken Conqueror's Haki like Zoro. Chapter 1193 hints at a different weapon. Which side are you on?
comment: Will Sanji win by awakening Conqueror's Haki, or by leading the giants? Pick one.

lines.text: Sanji doesn't need Conqueror's Haki to beat Killingham. Chapter 1193 already shows why.

shot.fallback: blond cook in a black suit mid kick

lines.text: Everyone keeps asking if Sanji gets a Zoro moment.
Zoro needed a Supreme King Haki breakthrough, because his fight was one on one.
In 1193 Killingham mocks him, and Sanji just kicks him in the stomach.

shot.fallback: kick to the stomach of a masked opponent

lines.text: Then the giants rally behind Sanji against Killingham's creation.

shot.fallback: giants raising weapons behind a small cook

lines.text: Sanji tells him it all depends on him. That isn't an awakening speech. It's a leader's speech.
Sure, people say a fight without a Haki upgrade is a lost fight.
But Killingham's whole plan needs the giants scared. Sanji just took that away.

shot.fallback: giants standing firm in front of a knight

lines.text: So here's my read: Sanji wins by making Elbaf fight with him, not by copying Zoro.

shot.fallback: cook leading a crowd of giants

lines.text: That's a theory, and I like it.
Sanji doesn't need Conqueror's Haki to beat Killingham...

self_check.hook: line 1 names the character and makes a claim

published.comment: Will Sanji win by awakening Conqueror's Haki, or by leading the giants? Pick one.
